scope: Production capture reader/VAD/controller/Web with explicitly substituted paced PCM source, real Silero/ASR/4B/TTS, file output and Firefox. No physical microphone/speaker/AEC qualification.
verified: Before change, a new microphone segment while busy was rejected and did not cancel the active turn; deterministic controller reproduction preserved
VAD confirms ongoing speech before endpoint, reserves one utterance and uses the existing cancellation owner to stop only the observed older turn
Actual native case: old model turn cancels, publishes no final WAV, then completed incoming speech reaches ASR/4B/TTS and produces the expected downloadable speech file
Completed new speech waits until native release; deterministic delayed-release test proves ASR is not started early and unrelated text cannot bypass reservation
Newer pending utterance replaces only unstarted input; old onset/cancel/segment cannot cancel or start a newer turn
Pending voice is discarded on explicit stop, palm stop, source epoch change, mute or TTL expiry; no model/tool dispatch for discarded input
Actual Firefox stop button targets the pending voice ID, and state returns to enabled text input after the old cancelled turn releases
Actual paced source mute discards the partial utterance while capture remains alive; resume starts a fresh input epoch
Actual PCM producer stalls, input marks failure, pending audio is discarded and only its owned subprocess/reader is closed; subsequent text/model/TTS still works
Half-duplex gate preserves user mute intent and requires quiet before rearming; confirmed-onset and long-utterance discard covered with deterministic VAD input
Overlong live speech drains until silence rather than executing a truncated command; short valid utterances may confirm at endpoint
Failed native capture-start substitutes close all owned stdout/stderr pipe handles; final application/source/model-deadline threads are released
known_limits: Audio discovery and recorder command are explicitly replaced in the native probe by a Python PCM producer. Console output from the inherited startup branch is not evidence of ALSA or physical capture.

The real-model interruption cases target LLM generation. Existing separate cancellation evidence covers native ASR/TTS; delayed native release and palm/pending ownership are deterministic regressions.
Speech onset confirmation is a development parameter, not measured microphone quality or an acoustic interruption latency promise
Physical device output permits speech interruption only when the configured software AEC is active; otherwise input processing is half-duplex and waits for quiet before rearming
Capture stream failure is terminal for live input in this version and asks for application restart after the device is checked; text/file requests remain usable
The 15s VAD limit is applied in whole 32ms frames including lookback/tail; an overlong utterance is rejected, not partially executed
Half-duplex/quiet policy, human false triggers, echoes and double-talk require later physical validation, explicitly deferred by the user
B0-SW is not yet collected; no autonomous performance tuning performed
verification_note: 155-test full suite and native browser run cover final behavior. Subsequent changes only format Python, update documentation/scope and remove an unused test variable.
